# M two events one word

`customer_support.mm.escalation_management.m_two_events_one_word` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Two different events wear the word "escalation": a relationship event the customer starts, and a process event we start. Different observers, different first moves, different definitions of done.

Nearly every escalation policy in circulation describes only the process event while practitioners spend most of their time in the relationship one. The merged model is why so much escalation training feels irrelevant to the people doing it.
